landing.heroLede: Measure the site, build the estimate from a catalogue with ready prices — and send your client a link where they see everything and sign online.
landing.heroNote: Free: 2 projects — portal, signing, PDF and photos. No card required
landing.tradesNote: Catalogue and templates — for your trade
landing.problemSubtitle: Estimates in Excel or a notebook. Areas calculated on a scrap of paper. Receipts get lost. And when the client asks “can I see the detail?” — you build it all over again.
landing.bad1: Areas worked out on a scrap of paper — then copied into every line
landing.bad2: Estimates in Excel or a notebook; the client gets a photo of the page
landing.bad3: Receipts get lost, costs are tracked from memory
landing.bad4: What you actually earned on a job — only in your head
landing.good1: Measure once — tick that area into any estimate line
landing.good2: The client opens a link and signs online, no registration
landing.good3: Snap a sketch or a receipt — lines and measurements fill themselves in
landing.good4: Costs against income — your net profit per project, as a number
landing.featuresTitle: Majstr keeps it in one place
landing.featuresSubtitle: Measurements → estimate → client → money. One project, the whole picture: what you measured, what you priced, what the client approved and what you earned on it.
landing.feature1Text: Rooms, walls, sloped ceilings, built partitions, window reveals. Complex shapes come with a diagram showing exactly what to measure. Calculate once — tick it into any estimate line. Ceilings in five rooms — one line, not five.
landing.feature2Title: Take a photo — it fills itself in
landing.feature2Text: Sketch a room with dimensions and snap it — measurements are created. Photo of a shop receipt — items land in the estimate. Your price list in Excel — imported in a minute. You just review and confirm.
landing.feature3Title: Your client sees and signs online
landing.feature3Text: Send a link or a PDF. They open it on their phone, review the estimate line by line and sign — no registration, no messenger back-and-forth. You see the status: viewed, signed.
landing.feature4Text: Add material and labour costs — and see your net profit on every project. Not a rough guess, a number. It's immediately clear which job paid off and where you undercharged.
landing.stepsTitle: Three steps from request to signature
landing.step1Text: The catalogue fills itself with market prices — for tiling, electrical, plumbing or construction. Adjust the prices to yours; only you see them. Got a price list in Excel — import it in a minute.
landing.step2Text: Room by room: walls, ceiling, floor, partitions, reveals. Complex mansard shapes come with a diagram to guide you. Or just photograph your sketch with its dimensions — it gets recognised.
landing.step3Title: Build the estimate and send it
landing.step3Text: Take a ready template for a typical job, tick in the areas from your measurements — and send the client a link. They approve it online.
landing.finalText: Registration takes a couple of minutes. A catalogue of 960+ works with prices and 140 ready templates are already inside. Two projects free: portal, signing, PDF and photos.
